chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Buses, drivers and the route through the states
summary: Moe Gale rented a Greyhound-type bus; they played all the main towns on the way west.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Now if we had to be in town or Ella had to be in town for a broadcast or publicity and stuff -- promoter, you know, like the tickets wasn't (inaudible), we really did it up big, you know. We'd have to leave right after that dance set and ride all night long. You had a driver, some one who was hired by Moe Gale? (inaudible) --

We had a driver that came with the bus, you know, from the company. We used to rent those Greyhound buses. We used to get seconds, you know. Like you can buy buses (inaudible). They had these buses -- This particular trip with Chick we had been using this bus on previous years, you know. So this fellow (inaudible). This company bought a brand new bus especially for Chick. I remember when he got this bus. He told Moe Gale, "I got a brand new bus for Chick's tour." It was like one those great big Trailway

bus like you have, the new ones (inaudible), you know. And that's what we had. We had that bus.
What of your accommodations?
Going to Kansas City that time, what states did you stay as you passed through, and did you stay overnight anywhere?
On the way out, we stopped in --
You know, we play like Cleveland, Detroit and all them towns. Anyway, if you're going to Kansas City, you play all the towns going in that particular area.
You play all down, you know. If you're going to California, you're going to Dallas, you play, like, you know -- the different states you go to --
You hit all the principal states.
Denver?
Denver and all that stuff.
Albuquerque?
Albuquerque. You know, we didn't play too much in Albuquerque, but we played

Salt Lak City?
Salt Lake City, yeah.
What kind of crowd did you have there?
Big. Even when I played Louie -- When I had Louie's band, we went up played that ballroom through Salt Lake City in '45-'44, (inaudible), there was a big crowd.
And the Mormon Tabernacle.
Did the band actually -- Did it just went through at night or did you stop --
No. We stopped in most -- Some of the towns we stayed over in. And then some of the towns --
